description: List e-Transport declarations from the last N days (at most 60): UIT code, declarant, trading partner, carrier, vehicle, and refused=true with ANAF's messages for a declaration it rejected. A notice field means ANAF refused or had nothing. Separate from e-Factura: it needs the ETRANSPORT role on the same grant.
